Tafel.title: Board
Tafel.enterHint: Enter to add, Shift+Enter for a new line
Tafel.emptyHint: Add a note above or dictate one via Telegram – it also shows up on the bulletin board.
Tafel.editHint: Enter to save, Shift+Enter for a new line, Esc to cancel
Tafel.confirmDeleteText: The entry will also be removed from the bulletin board (TV).
Tafel.reorderError: Could not save the new order
